choice.description: How must warranty claim WD-26-30417 be classified under WS-2024?

contexts:
VELDHOVEN AUDIO B.V. — WARRANTY DESK (Amsterdam), CASE WD-26-30417
Product: Veldhoven Reference R7 active studio monitor, serial VA-R7-TL-2412-00873.
Customer: Hollis Street Sound LLC, Los Angeles, USA (commercial customer).

Warranty Statement WS-2024 (applies to units sold from 1 January 2024)
§1 The warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship for 24 months from the date of delivery to the first end customer.
§2 The 24-month period is extended by the number of days a unit spent at an authorised service centre for a repair accepted under this warranty, counted from the day of receipt at the centre to the day of dispatch back to the customer, both inclusive.
§3 A claim is made on the claim date: the date on which the fault is first reported through the Veldhoven service portal. The claim date is determined from the portal's timestamp in Amsterdam time (the portal operates on Amsterdam time for all regions).
§4 Units sold before 1 January 2024 remain under WS-2019 (18 months from delivery, no extension).
§5 Consumables (grille cloth, rubber feet) are excluded.
§6 Notwithstanding §§1–2, no claim is accepted after the end of the 30th month following the date of manufacture. This limit is not extended by repair days or for any other reason.
§7 Date of manufacture: the serial number format is VA-<model>-<plant>-<YYWW>-<sequence>, where YYWW is the ISO year and ISO week of manufacture; the date of manufacture is deemed to be the Monday of that ISO week.
§8 Periods in months end on the corresponding calendar day of the final month.

Unit history
Sold via distributor Pacific Pro Audio; delivered to Hollis Street Sound on 5 September 2024 (carrier proof of delivery).
Repair RMA-25-11020: tweeter failure, accepted under warranty. Received at the Burbank service centre 3 November 2025; repaired 18 November; dispatched back 24 November 2025.
Second unit of the same pair: serial VA-R7-TL-2414-00911, delivered the same day, no repairs.

New fault report (portal ticket 7730-A): "Left monitor (…-2412-00873) — woofer rattles at low volume." Portal timestamp: 2026-09-19 02:10:44 UTC.
Customer follow-up e-mail: "We logged this on Friday afternoon, September 18, well inside your warranty — the repair last year extended it to late September."
Calendar reference: ISO week 12 of 2024 runs Monday 18 March – Sunday 24 March 2024. Amsterdam is on CEST (UTC+2) in September 2026; Los Angeles on PDT (UTC−7).
